findings.observation: Every typed prefix received suggestions (10 of 10).
findings.customer_impact: Customers get guidance before submitting a search, reducing typing effort and misses.
findings.business_impact: Assisted queries convert better than unassisted ones.
findings.recommendation: Verify the visible dropdown matches the API suggestions once rendered capture (P008) lands.

findings.observation: Every rendered search page showed products to the customer (5 of 5), verified in a real browser with screenshots retained.
findings.customer_impact: What the search API returns is actually reaching the customer-facing page.
findings.business_impact: Endpoint-level results are confirmed as customer-visible, strengthening every search claim in this report.
findings.recommendation: Keep rendered capture in the regression loop so theme or search-app changes that break the visible experience are caught.

findings.observation: No visible autocomplete dropdown was captured for any typed query, while the suggest endpoint returns suggestions.
findings.customer_impact: Customers may not be receiving the type-ahead assistance the endpoint evidence implies.
findings.business_impact: Autocomplete claims in this report are endpoint-verified but not confirmed as customer-visible.
findings.recommendation: Verify whether the storefront uses a third-party search app or a theme that suppresses the native dropdown.
